candidate_manifests.description: Raw v28 YES-axis probability from the feature table.
One-dimensional train-only logistic recalibration of v28.
Book/source-aware diagnostic logistic surface; never pure FV evidence by itself.
Ten-bin monotonic tabular calibration of v28 probability, fit on train only.
Boundary-only monotonic correction: full inside abs(d_sigma)<=1, linearly tapered to raw v28 by abs(d_sigma)>=2.
Conservative one-third-strength boundary-only monotonic correction, frozen separately for future evidence.
Tiny boundary monotonic correction that is disabled inside the final 240 seconds and fades in by 600 seconds, frozen separately for future evidence.
Micro-strength boundary monotonic correction using the same causal time gate as the time-safe candidate; frozen separately and starts forward evidence only after this manifest exists.
Fixed late-window d_sigma logit residual: no change at or beyond 600 seconds, full conservative counter-tilt inside 240 seconds, and no retrospective credit before this manifest exists.

residual_terms.rationale: Final-average settlement should be less sensitive to instantaneous signed boundary distance as close approaches.

notes: Models are trained on train split only.
Promotion is closed for posthoc source rows and zero post-lock forward rows.
This run uses logged v28 event features with posthoc seed labels; it is diagnostic-only.
